name: exporb-events
description: Find upcoming B2B trade shows, industry conferences and exhibitions worldwide from ChatGPT. Search by topic, country, continent, event type and date range, look up one event to get its dates, city, country and official website, and see which countries have the most upcoming events. Every result links to its page on exporb.com/events. The plugin is read-only: it only reads a public events directory, needs no account or login, never changes anything and never sees your conversation. It does not sell tickets, book travel or register you for events. Built for exhibitors, sponsors, sales and marketing teams, event planners and researchers who need to decide which trade shows to attend and when. Event data comes from public sources and is reviewed before it appears, so confirm dates and venues on the official event website before you travel. Ask in plain language, for example which trade shows are in Germany in November or which countries have the most upcoming trade shows.

interface.longDescription:
Exporb Events helps you find upcoming B2B trade shows, industry conferences and exhibitions from inside ChatGPT. Describe what you are looking for in plain language and the plugin searches the Exporb events directory, the same directory published at exporb.com/events, then returns real events with dates, locations and links.

WHAT YOU CAN DO
- Search upcoming events by topic or keyword, for example robotics, fintech, logistics, healthcare, packaging, energy or food.
- Narrow results by country, continent, event type (such as trade show or conference) and date range.
- Search by event name, even a partial one.
- Ask for a country overview: which countries have the most upcoming trade shows and how many events each one has. Use it to check how well a market is covered before you search inside it.
- Open one event to get its dates, city, country, event type, a short description where one exists, and its official website.
- Page through results a few events at a time, soonest first. By default only events that have not ended yet are shown. Ask for past events if you want to look back.

EXAMPLE QUESTIONS
- Which trade shows are in Germany in November?
- Find robotics and automation conferences in the US over the next six months.
- Show B2B events in Dubai between January and March next year.
- Which countries have the most upcoming trade shows?
- Tell me about the European Taxi Fair: dates, city and official website.
- List fintech conferences in Europe in 2027.
- What trade shows take place in Asia in the first quarter?

WHAT YOU GET BACK
Each result includes the event name, start and end dates, city, country, continent, event type and a link to the event's page on Exporb. A single-event lookup also returns the organiser's official website when it is known. Results are structured, so ChatGPT can compare events, build a short list, sort by date or group by country for you.

WHO IT IS FOR
- Exhibitors, sponsors and sales teams planning which shows to attend and when.
- Marketing and event managers building a yearly event calendar.
- Business travellers and event planners checking dates and cities.
- Founders, analysts and researchers mapping the event landscape of an industry or region.

TIPS FOR BETTER RESULTS
- Name a topic and a place in the same question, for example "medical device shows in Germany".
- Give a time frame such as "next quarter" or "between March and June" so results are limited to the dates you care about.

LIMITATIONS
- It finds and describes events. It does not sell tickets, book travel or register you for events.
- It covers B2B trade shows, industry conferences and exhibitions. It is not meant for consumer events, concerts or sports.
- Each page returns up to 10 results and up to 3 pages are available. For anything deeper, refine the topic, country or dates.
- Event information comes from public sources and can change. Always confirm dates, venue and registration on the official event website before you commit to travel or spend.
- Coverage differs by country and industry. If nothing matches, the plugin says so instead of inventing events.
- Events appear after they have been reviewed and approved for the directory.

PRIVACY AND ACCESS
- No account or login is needed.
- The tools are read-only. They only read a public events directory. They never change anything and cannot see your conversation, your files or your other connected apps.
- The plugin receives only the search terms and filters needed to answer your question. See the privacy policy, section "Exporb Events in ChatGPT", for how rate limiting and aggregate usage counts work.

ABOUT THE DIRECTORY
The events directory is published by Exporb at exporb.com/events. Every result links to its own event page there, so you can open the full listing, check the details and find the official event website. Event pages are updated as new events are approved and as dates or links change, and the plugin reads the same up-to-date directory each time you ask.

defaultPrompt: Which B2B trade shows are in Germany between November and February? Show dates, cities and links.
Find robotics and automation conferences in the US over the next six months, soonest first.
Which countries have the most upcoming trade shows, and what are the next events in the top one?

positive.description: Search events by country. The reviewer asks a country-level question with a loose time frame. ChatGPT should call search_events with country set to Germany and the default start date of today, and list a handful of upcoming events soonest first. This confirms the country filter, the default 'not ended yet' behaviour and the result format.
positive.prompt: Which trade shows are in Germany in the next few months?
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming trade shows in Germany, soonest first, each with name, start and end dates, city and an exporb.com link. At most 10 results per page, and it says when more pages exist. No ticket, booking or registration offers appear.

positive.description: Search events by topic. The reviewer asks for a topic with no country or date. ChatGPT should pass the topic as the free-text query and return upcoming matches worldwide. This confirms keyword search and that the plugin does not invent events when the topic has few matches.
positive.expected_behavior: Lists upcoming robotics-related events with dates, location and an exporb.com link for each. If nothing matches, the answer says so plainly and suggests broadening the topic or dates, without inventing events.

positive.description: Look up one event. The reviewer asks about one named event. ChatGPT should first find the event with search_events to get its slug, then call get_event for the details. This confirms the two-step lookup and that the official website is returned by get_event.
positive.prompt: Tell me about the European Taxi Fair: dates, city and official website.
positive.expected_behavior: Finds the event, then returns its dates, city, country, event type, official website and a link to its page on Exporb. If the event is not in the directory, the answer says so.

positive.description: List countries with events. The reviewer asks a coverage question, not a search. ChatGPT should call list_countries, which takes no input, and present the ranking. This confirms the overview tool and that counts come from the directory.
positive.prompt: Which countries have the most upcoming trade shows?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns countries ranked by number of upcoming events, with the event count for each. The list reflects the live directory, so numbers change as events are added or finish.

positive.description: Filter by date range. The reviewer combines a place with a date window. ChatGPT should convert the months to ISO dates for date_from and date_to and filter by the matching country. This confirms the date-range filters and that ChatGPT states clearly when no events fall in the window.
positive.prompt: Show B2B events in Dubai between January and March next year.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns events in the UAE within the requested date range, soonest first, each with an exporb.com link, or states that none were found for those dates.

negative.description: Ticket purchase not supported: the plugin only finds events and must not claim to buy tickets, book travel or register the user.
negative.prompt: Buy me two tickets to the biggest trade show in Las Vegas.

negative.description: Full database dump not supported: results are capped at 10 per page and 3 pages, so the plugin must not export every event or all fields.
negative.prompt: Export every event in your database as a CSV with all fields.

negative.description: Unrelated request: the plugin should not be used for general coding or any task that is not about finding B2B events.
negative.prompt: Write a Python script that sorts a list of numbers.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products or process payments. It only reads a public events directory.

publication.release_notes: Version 1.1.1. Search upcoming B2B trade shows, conferences and exhibitions by topic, country, continent, event type and date range; look up one event for its dates, city, country, description and official website; and list countries with upcoming events and their counts. Results are read-only, need no login and link to the event page on exporb.com. Changes since 1.0.0: category set to Business & Operations, a fuller listing description, more capabilities and starter prompts, a demo recording URL, detailed test cases, listing translations in 29 languages, and a usage skill that guides ChatGPT on choosing tools and setting date filters.

es-ES.subtitle: Busca ferias B2B en el mundo
es-ES.description: Encuentra ferias B2B, congresos y exposiciones del sector por tema, país, continente, tipo de evento y fecha. Pregunta, por ejemplo: «¿Qué ferias hay en Alemania en noviembre?». Cada resultado incluye el nombre, las fechas, la ciudad y el país del evento con un enlace a su página en Exporb, y la consulta de un solo evento devuelve también el sitio web oficial. Las herramientas solo leen un directorio público de eventos: no modifican nada ni acceden a tus datos. Este plugin no vende entradas, no reserva viajes ni te inscribe en eventos.

fr-FR.subtitle: Trouvez des salons B2B
fr-FR.description: Trouvez des salons professionnels, conférences et expositions B2B par thème, pays, continent, type d'événement et date. Demandez par exemple : « Quels salons ont lieu en Allemagne en novembre ? ». Chaque résultat indique le nom, les dates, la ville et le pays de l'événement avec un lien vers sa page sur Exporb, et la recherche d'un seul événement renvoie aussi le site officiel. Les outils lisent uniquement un annuaire public d'événements : ils ne modifient rien et n'accèdent pas à vos données. Ce plugin ne vend pas de billets, ne réserve pas de voyages et ne vous inscrit pas à des événements.

de-DE.subtitle: B2B-Messen weltweit finden
de-DE.description: Finde B2B-Messen, Fachkonferenzen und Ausstellungen nach Thema, Land, Kontinent, Veranstaltungsart und Datum. Frage zum Beispiel: „Welche Messen finden im November in Deutschland statt?“. Jedes Ergebnis nennt Name, Termin, Stadt und Land der Veranstaltung mit einem Link zur Seite bei Exporb; die Abfrage einer einzelnen Veranstaltung liefert zusätzlich die offizielle Website. Die Tools lesen nur ein öffentliches Veranstaltungsverzeichnis: Sie ändern nichts und sehen deine Daten nicht. Dieses Plugin verkauft keine Tickets, bucht keine Reisen und meldet dich nicht für Veranstaltungen an.

it-IT.subtitle: Trova fiere B2B nel mondo
it-IT.description: Trova fiere B2B, conferenze di settore ed esposizioni per tema, paese, continente, tipo di evento e data. Chiedi, per esempio: «Quali fiere ci sono in Germania a novembre?». Ogni risultato riporta nome, date, città e paese dell'evento con un link alla sua pagina su Exporb, e la ricerca di un singolo evento restituisce anche il sito ufficiale. Gli strumenti leggono solo un elenco pubblico di eventi: non modificano nulla e non vedono i tuoi dati. Questo plugin non vende biglietti, non prenota viaggi e non ti iscrive agli eventi.

pt-BR.subtitle: Encontre feiras B2B no mundo
pt-BR.description: Encontre feiras B2B, conferências do setor e exposições por tema, país, continente, tipo de evento e data. Pergunte, por exemplo: "Quais feiras acontecem na Alemanha em novembro?". Cada resultado traz nome, datas, cidade e país do evento, com um link para a página dele na Exporb, e a consulta de um único evento também retorna o site oficial. As ferramentas apenas leem um diretório público de eventos: não alteram nada e não acessam seus dados. Este plugin não vende ingressos, não reserva viagens e não faz inscrições em eventos.

pt-PT.subtitle: Encontre feiras B2B no mundo
pt-PT.description: Encontre feiras B2B, conferências do setor e exposições por tema, país, continente, tipo de evento e data. Pergunte, por exemplo: «Que feiras há na Alemanha em novembro?». Cada resultado indica o nome, as datas, a cidade e o país do evento, com uma ligação para a página dele na Exporb, e a consulta de um único evento devolve também o site oficial. As ferramentas apenas leem um diretório público de eventos: não alteram nada nem acedem aos seus dados. Este plugin não vende bilhetes, não reserva viagens nem o inscreve em eventos.

nl-NL.subtitle: Vind B2B-beurzen wereldwijd
nl-NL.description: Vind B2B-beurzen, vakconferenties en tentoonstellingen op onderwerp, land, continent, soort evenement en datum. Vraag bijvoorbeeld: "Welke beurzen zijn er in november in Duitsland?". Elk resultaat toont de naam, data, stad en land van het evenement met een link naar de pagina op Exporb, en het opzoeken van één evenement geeft ook de officiële website. De tools lezen alleen een openbare evenementengids: ze wijzigen niets en zien je gegevens niet. Deze plugin verkoopt geen tickets, boekt geen reizen en schrijft je niet in voor evenementen.

pl-PL.subtitle: Znajdź targi B2B na świecie
pl-PL.description: Znajdź targi B2B, konferencje branżowe i wystawy według tematu, kraju, kontynentu, rodzaju wydarzenia i daty. Zapytaj na przykład: „Jakie targi odbywają się w listopadzie w Niemczech?”. Każdy wynik zawiera nazwę, daty, miasto i kraj wydarzenia wraz z linkiem do jego strony w Exporb, a wyszukanie jednego wydarzenia zwraca też oficjalną stronę internetową. Narzędzia tylko odczytują publiczny katalog wydarzeń: niczego nie zmieniają i nie widzą Twoich danych. Wtyczka nie sprzedaje biletów, nie rezerwuje podróży i nie zapisuje na wydarzenia.

tr-TR.subtitle: Dünya çapında B2B fuarları
tr-TR.description: B2B fuarlarını, sektör konferanslarını ve sergileri konuya, ülkeye, kıtaya, etkinlik türüne ve tarihe göre bulun. Örneğin şunu sorun: "Kasım ayında Almanya'da hangi fuarlar var?". Her sonuç etkinliğin adını, tarihlerini, şehrini ve ülkesini Exporb'daki sayfasına bağlantıyla birlikte verir; tek bir etkinliğin sorgulanması resmi web sitesini de döndürür. Araçlar yalnızca herkese açık bir etkinlik dizinini okur: hiçbir şeyi değiştirmez ve verilerinizi görmez. Bu eklenti bilet satmaz, seyahat rezervasyonu yapmaz ve sizi etkinliklere kaydetmez.

ru-RU.subtitle: Найдите B2B-выставки в мире
ru-RU.description: Находите B2B-выставки, отраслевые конференции и экспозиции по теме, стране, континенту, типу события и дате. Спросите, например: «Какие выставки пройдут в Германии в ноябре?». Каждый результат содержит название, даты, город и страну события со ссылкой на его страницу в Exporb, а поиск одного события также возвращает официальный сайт. Инструменты только читают публичный каталог событий: они ничего не изменяют и не видят ваши данные. Плагин не продаёт билеты, не бронирует поездки и не регистрирует вас на события.

uk-UA.subtitle: Знайдіть B2B-виставки у світі
uk-UA.description: Знаходьте B2B-виставки, галузеві конференції та експозиції за темою, країною, континентом, типом події та датою. Запитайте, наприклад: «Які виставки відбудуться в Німеччині в листопаді?». Кожен результат містить назву, дати, місто й країну події з посиланням на її сторінку в Exporb, а пошук однієї події також повертає офіційний сайт. Інструменти лише читають публічний каталог подій: вони нічого не змінюють і не бачать ваших даних. Плагін не продає квитки, не бронює подорожі й не реєструє вас на події.

ar-SA.subtitle: اعثر على معارض B2B حول العالم
ar-SA.description: اعثر على معارض B2B والمؤتمرات الصناعية والمعارض التجارية حسب الموضوع والدولة والقارة ونوع الحدث والتاريخ. اسأل مثلًا: «ما المعارض التي تُقام في ألمانيا في نوفمبر؟». تعرض كل نتيجة اسم الحدث وتواريخه ومدينته ودولته مع رابط إلى صفحته على Exporb، كما يعيد البحث عن حدث واحد الموقع الرسمي. تقرأ الأدوات دليلًا عامًا للفعاليات فقط، فلا تغيّر أي شيء ولا ترى بياناتك. لا تبيع هذه الإضافة التذاكر ولا تحجز الرحلات ولا تسجّلك في الفعاليات.

he-IL.subtitle: מצאו תערוכות B2B בעולם
he-IL.description: מצאו תערוכות B2B, כנסים מקצועיים ותערוכות לפי נושא, מדינה, יבשת, סוג אירוע ותאריך. אפשר לשאול, למשל: "אילו תערוכות יש בגרמניה בנובמבר?". כל תוצאה כוללת את שם האירוע, התאריכים, העיר והמדינה עם קישור לדף שלו ב-Exporb, וחיפוש של אירוע בודד מחזיר גם את האתר הרשמי. הכלים רק קוראים מדריך אירועים ציבורי: הם לא משנים דבר ולא רואים את הנתונים שלכם. התוסף אינו מוכר כרטיסים, אינו מזמין נסיעות ואינו רושם אתכם לאירועים.

hi-IN.subtitle: B2B ट्रेड शो खोजें
hi-IN.description: विषय, देश, महाद्वीप, इवेंट के प्रकार और तारीख के आधार पर B2B ट्रेड शो, उद्योग सम्मेलन और प्रदर्शनियाँ खोजें। उदाहरण के लिए पूछें: "नवंबर में जर्मनी में कौन-से ट्रेड शो हैं?"। हर परिणाम में इवेंट का नाम, तारीखें, शहर और देश के साथ Exporb पर उसके पेज का लिंक मिलता है, और किसी एक इवेंट की खोज आधिकारिक वेबसाइट भी देती है। ये टूल केवल एक सार्वजनिक इवेंट डायरेक्टरी पढ़ते हैं: वे कुछ बदलते नहीं और आपका डेटा नहीं देखते। यह प्लगइन टिकट नहीं बेचता, यात्रा बुक नहीं करता और आपको इवेंट में रजिस्टर नहीं करता।

id-ID.subtitle: Cari pameran B2B di dunia
id-ID.description: Temukan pameran dagang B2B, konferensi industri, dan eksibisi berdasarkan topik, negara, benua, jenis acara, dan tanggal. Tanyakan misalnya: "Pameran apa saja di Jerman pada bulan November?". Setiap hasil memuat nama acara, tanggal, kota, dan negara dengan tautan ke halamannya di Exporb, dan pencarian satu acara juga memberikan situs web resminya. Alat ini hanya membaca direktori acara publik: tidak mengubah apa pun dan tidak melihat data Anda. Plugin ini tidak menjual tiket, tidak memesan perjalanan, dan tidak mendaftarkan Anda ke acara.

ja-JP.subtitle: 世界のB2B展示会を検索
ja-JP.description: テーマ、国、大陸、イベントの種類、日付からB2B展示会、業界カンファレンス、エキスポを探せます。たとえば「11月にドイツで開催される展示会は?」と質問してください。各結果にはイベント名、日程、開催都市、国と、Exporb上のイベントページへのリンクが含まれ、1件のイベントを調べると公式サイトも返されます。このツールは公開イベントディレクトリを読み取るだけで、何も変更せず、あなたのデータにもアクセスしません。このプラグインはチケット販売、旅行の予約、イベントへの登録は行いません。

ko-KR.subtitle: 전 세계 B2B 박람회 찾기
ko-KR.description: 주제, 국가, 대륙, 행사 유형, 날짜별로 B2B 박람회, 업계 콘퍼런스, 전시회를 찾아보세요. 예를 들어 "11월에 독일에서 열리는 박람회는?"이라고 물어보세요. 각 결과에는 행사 이름, 날짜, 도시, 국가와 Exporb의 행사 페이지 링크가 포함되며, 단일 행사를 조회하면 공식 웹사이트도 함께 제공됩니다. 이 도구는 공개 행사 디렉터리를 읽기만 하며 아무것도 변경하지 않고 사용자 데이터에도 접근하지 않습니다. 이 플러그인은 티켓 판매, 여행 예약, 행사 등록을 하지 않습니다.

zh-CN.subtitle: 查找全球B2B展会
zh-CN.description: 按主题、国家、大洲、活动类型和日期查找B2B展会、行业会议和展览。例如可以问:“11月德国有哪些展会?”每条结果都包含活动名称、日期、城市和国家,并附有其在Exporb上的页面链接;查询单个活动时还会返回官方网站。这些工具只读取公开的活动目录,不会更改任何内容,也看不到您的数据。本插件不出售门票,不预订行程,也不为您报名参加活动。

zh-TW.subtitle: 尋找全球B2B展會
zh-TW.description: 依主題、國家、洲別、活動類型與日期尋找B2B展會、產業研討會與展覽。例如可以問:「11月德國有哪些展會?」每筆結果都包含活動名稱、日期、城市與國家,並附上其在Exporb的頁面連結;查詢單一活動時也會提供官方網站。這些工具只會讀取公開的活動目錄,不會變更任何內容,也看不到您的資料。本外掛不販售門票、不預訂行程,也不代為報名活動。

vi-VN.subtitle: Tìm hội chợ B2B toàn cầu
vi-VN.description: Tìm hội chợ thương mại B2B, hội nghị ngành và triển lãm theo chủ đề, quốc gia, châu lục, loại sự kiện và ngày. Ví dụ, hãy hỏi: "Tháng 11 ở Đức có hội chợ nào?". Mỗi kết quả cho biết tên sự kiện, ngày, thành phố và quốc gia kèm liên kết đến trang của sự kiện trên Exporb, và khi tra cứu một sự kiện sẽ có thêm trang web chính thức. Các công cụ chỉ đọc một danh bạ sự kiện công khai: không thay đổi gì và không xem dữ liệu của bạn. Plugin này không bán vé, không đặt chuyến đi và không đăng ký bạn tham gia sự kiện.

th-TH.subtitle: ค้นหางานแสดงสินค้า B2B
th-TH.description: ค้นหางานแสดงสินค้า B2B การประชุมอุตสาหกรรม และนิทรรศการ ตามหัวข้อ ประเทศ ทวีป ประเภทงาน และวันที่ ลองถามว่า "เดือนพฤศจิกายนที่เยอรมนีมีงานแสดงสินค้าอะไรบ้าง" ผลลัพธ์แต่ละรายการมีชื่องาน วันที่ เมือง และประเทศ พร้อมลิงก์ไปยังหน้าของงานบน Exporb และการค้นหางานเดียวจะแสดงเว็บไซต์ทางการด้วย เครื่องมืออ่านเฉพาะไดเรกทอรีงานสาธารณะ ไม่เปลี่ยนแปลงสิ่งใดและไม่เห็นข้อมูลของคุณ ปลั๊กอินนี้ไม่ขายบัตร ไม่จองการเดินทาง และไม่ลงทะเบียนเข้างานให้คุณ

sv-SE.subtitle: Hitta B2B-mässor världen över
sv-SE.description: Hitta B2B-mässor, branschkonferenser och utställningar efter ämne, land, kontinent, evenemangstyp och datum. Fråga till exempel: "Vilka mässor är det i Tyskland i november?". Varje resultat visar evenemangets namn, datum, stad och land med en länk till dess sida på Exporb, och en sökning på ett enskilt evenemang ger även den officiella webbplatsen. Verktygen läser bara en offentlig evenemangskatalog: de ändrar ingenting och ser inte dina uppgifter. Pluginet säljer inga biljetter, bokar inga resor och anmäler dig inte till evenemang.

da-DK.subtitle: Find B2B-messer verden over
da-DK.description: Find B2B-messer, branchekonferencer og udstillinger efter emne, land, kontinent, eventtype og dato. Spørg for eksempel: "Hvilke messer er der i Tyskland i november?". Hvert resultat viser eventets navn, datoer, by og land med et link til dets side på Exporb, og opslag på ét event giver også den officielle hjemmeside. Værktøjerne læser kun en offentlig eventoversigt: de ændrer ingenting og ser ikke dine data. Pluginet sælger ikke billetter, booker ikke rejser og tilmelder dig ikke events.

nb-NO.subtitle: Finn B2B-messer i hele verden
nb-NO.description: Finn B2B-messer, bransjekonferanser og utstillinger etter tema, land, kontinent, arrangementstype og dato. Spør for eksempel: "Hvilke messer er det i Tyskland i november?". Hvert resultat viser arrangementets navn, datoer, by og land med en lenke til siden på Exporb, og oppslag på ett arrangement gir også den offisielle nettsiden. Verktøyene leser bare en offentlig arrangementsoversikt: de endrer ingenting og ser ikke dataene dine. Utvidelsen selger ikke billetter, bestiller ikke reiser og melder deg ikke på arrangementer.

fi-FI.subtitle: Löydä B2B-messut maailmalta
fi-FI.description: Löydä B2B-messut, alan konferenssit ja näyttelyt aiheen, maan, maanosan, tapahtumatyypin ja päivämäärän mukaan. Kysy esimerkiksi: "Mitkä messut ovat Saksassa marraskuussa?". Jokaisessa tuloksessa on tapahtuman nimi, päivämäärät, kaupunki ja maa sekä linkki sen sivulle Exporbissa, ja yksittäisen tapahtuman haku palauttaa myös viralliset verkkosivut. Työkalut vain lukevat julkista tapahtumahakemistoa: ne eivät muuta mitään eivätkä näe tietojasi. Lisäosa ei myy lippuja, varaa matkoja eikä ilmoita sinua tapahtumiin.

cs-CZ.subtitle: Najděte B2B veletrhy světa
cs-CZ.description: Najděte B2B veletrhy, odborné konference a výstavy podle tématu, země, kontinentu, typu akce a data. Zeptejte se například: "Jaké veletrhy jsou v listopadu v Německu?". Každý výsledek uvádí název, termín, město a zemi akce s odkazem na její stránku na Exporbu a vyhledání jedné akce vrátí také oficiální web. Nástroje pouze čtou veřejný adresář akcí: nic nemění a nevidí vaše data. Doplněk neprodává vstupenky, nerezervuje cesty a nepřihlašuje vás na akce.

el-GR.subtitle: Βρείτε B2B εκθέσεις
el-GR.description: Βρείτε B2B εμπορικές εκθέσεις, επαγγελματικά συνέδρια και εκθέσεις ανά θέμα, χώρα, ήπειρο, τύπο εκδήλωσης και ημερομηνία. Ρωτήστε για παράδειγμα: «Ποιες εκθέσεις γίνονται τον Νοέμβριο στη Γερμανία;». Κάθε αποτέλεσμα δείχνει το όνομα, τις ημερομηνίες, την πόλη και τη χώρα της εκδήλωσης με σύνδεσμο προς τη σελίδα της στο Exporb, ενώ η αναζήτηση μίας εκδήλωσης επιστρέφει και τον επίσημο ιστότοπο. Τα εργαλεία διαβάζουν μόνο έναν δημόσιο κατάλογο εκδηλώσεων: δεν αλλάζουν τίποτα και δεν βλέπουν τα δεδομένα σας. Το πρόσθετο δεν πουλά εισιτήρια, δεν κλείνει ταξίδια και δεν σας εγγράφει σε εκδηλώσεις.

ro-RO.subtitle: Găsește târguri B2B în lume
ro-RO.description: Găsește târguri B2B, conferințe de industrie și expoziții după temă, țară, continent, tipul evenimentului și dată. Întreabă, de exemplu: "Ce târguri sunt în Germania în noiembrie?". Fiecare rezultat arată numele, datele, orașul și țara evenimentului, cu un link către pagina lui de pe Exporb, iar căutarea unui singur eveniment returnează și site-ul oficial. Instrumentele citesc doar un director public de evenimente: nu schimbă nimic și nu îți văd datele. Pluginul nu vinde bilete, nu rezervă călătorii și nu te înscrie la evenimente.

hu-HU.subtitle: Találj B2B kiállításokat
hu-HU.description: Találj B2B szakkiállításokat, iparági konferenciákat és kiállításokat téma, ország, kontinens, eseménytípus és dátum szerint. Kérdezd például: "Milyen kiállítások vannak novemberben Németországban?". Minden találat megadja az esemény nevét, időpontját, városát és országát az Exporb-on lévő oldalára mutató hivatkozással, egyetlen esemény lekérdezése pedig a hivatalos weboldalt is megadja. Az eszközök csak egy nyilvános eseménykatalógust olvasnak: nem módosítanak semmit, és nem látják az adataidat. A bővítmény nem árul jegyet, nem foglal utazást, és nem regisztrál téged eseményekre.
